get_ui_config: get the UI config endpoint that returns server root path, proxy base URL, SSO status, and worker registry
test_get_ui_config: test the get_ui_config endpoint returns UiDiscoveryEndpoints with sso_configured and admin_ui_disabled fields
review_get_ui_config: review the get_ui_config endpoint that reads AUTO_REDIRECT_UI_LOGIN_TO_SSO and DISABLE_ADMIN_UI environment variables
build_ui_discovery_model: build a pydantic model UiDiscoveryEndpoints with server_root_path, proxy_base_url, sso_configured, and workers fields
summarize_ui_discovery: summarize the ui_discovery_endpoints module that exposes GET routes for /.well-known/litellm-ui-config discovery
